thread:
anya: Quick sync — proposal for 'launch anchors' for new catalog entries + compatibility shim cost tradeoffs.

TL;DR: suggest a 2-week soft pin on new model versions for affected customers, must pass benchmark gate, then staged canary (1%→10%→50%→100%). Need eng + ops estimates on shim infra and routing work. Thoughts?

jamie: what's the exact definition of a 'launch anchor' here? :thinking:

anya: good q — anchor = temporary pin + safety guard. It gives customers a predictable model while we monitor for regressions. soft pin = opt-out piece, auto-unpin after 2w unless customer requests extension.

matt: from infra side: what are the benchmark gates? latency/quality/cost thresholds?

sree: if we're keeping compatibility shims (old quantized jars + shims for tokenizer differences) we should estimate infra. Ballpark: maintaining 2 extra model variants = ~80 GPU-hrs/month for warm cache on Dedicated -> ~$400/mo in infra at current rates. (need exact calc)

olivia: some enterprise customers want 90-day guarantee. can we do paid pin exceptions? that's what sales will push for.

leo: routing idea: weighted routing with automatic fallback triggered by eval alerts. implementable via policy: if quality drop >5% on eval set -> route X% to previous variant and open incident.

dev-bot: Created ticket #CAT-1298 for 'launch-anchor policy design' and linked docs: https://go.redwood/cat/1298 :white_check_mark:

jamie: propose canary cadence: 1% for 24h, 10% for 48h, 50% for 7d, 100% full rollout. we should also schedule a 'quality hold' check at each stage.

matt: rollback criteria: (1) error rate >1% above baseline OR (2) latency p95 >2x baseline OR (3) eval pass rate drop >=5% on hold set. If any triggered, automatic rollback + notify customer set.

sree: eng effort estimate request: routing + policy enforcement ~2w, metrics/alerts ~1w, shim packaging & CI ~1-2w. total ~4-5w of eng work with one eng + one infra owner.

anya: decision items
- agree to 'soft pin' default 2w
- canary cadence as jamie suggested
- benchmark gates: p95 latency <= 1.5x baseline (though matt suggested <300ms), eval pass >=95% on QA set, cost delta <=10%
- offer paid 90-day pin for enterprise (olivia follow up with sales)
- eng to scope tickets (sree/matt): routing policy, shim infra, metrics

next steps: sree to confirm infra cost with exact numbers, matt to draft rollback playbook, olivia to list customers likely to request 90-day pins, jamie to schedule 30m sync for Monday.

anya: thanks — tagging @sree @matt @olivia to confirm timelines. :sparkles:
